With the aid of Polyjuice Potion, Ron, Hermione and others take his form to detract suspicion, but things swiftly go wrong as Death Eaters descend on the group – leading to a heroic sacrifice from one of his oldest friends.

snippet.title: 'Did you put your name in the Goblet of Fire?' | Full Scene | Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
snippet.description:
As the start of the Triwizard Tournament draws near, the names of three champions from Beauxbatons, Durmstrang and Hogwarts are chosen by the Goblet of Fire. Things take an unexpected twist, however, when a fourth champion is selected: Harry Potter. Accusations of cheating, conspiracy and dark magic abound as Dumbledore asks a very important question.
